title: Primary Windows platform architecture correction

change_control.trigger: The intended deployment machine was clarified as the NVIDIA DGX Station for Windows, whose NVIDIA Grace CPU is Arm64 rather than x64.
change_control.necessity: B02 cannot truthfully qualify an Arm64 product target while the B00 scope authority and B02 exit gate require only Windows 11 x64.
change_control.scope: Narrow platform correction only. The one-owner promise, ten workflows, non-goals, B00-B16 order, feature freeze, evidence standard, post-10 queue, and commercial separation do not change.
change_control.governance_handling: The platform portion of the 2026-08-11 B00 closure finding is superseded by this amendment. B00 is revalidated and remains closed only if the amended authorities, generated documents, links, and governance self-tests pass. B02 remains the sole active implementation batch.

superseded_claim.preservation: The original closure record remains unchanged as historical evidence; it must be read with this amendment.

b02_required_matrix: A complete unattended native Windows 11 Arm64 lane.
A complete unattended native Windows 11 x64 lane.
Both lanes attest the same exact source commit and architecture-specific exact locks.
Fail-closed aggregation validates both evidence bundles before B03 can unlock.
non_substitution_rules: An x64 pass does not qualify Arm64.
An emulated x64 process on Arm64 is not native Arm64 evidence.
Static inspection is not execution evidence.
Hosted native Arm64 B02 evidence does not prove physical DGX GPU/model throughput, latency, device integration, or sustained owner use.

deferred_physical_dgx_gates.B11: Local voice/model and declared audio-hardware qualification.
deferred_physical_dgx_gates.B13: Target-hardware performance, resource, UX, and accessibility budgets.
deferred_physical_dgx_gates.B15: Thirty consecutive days of exact-candidate owner dogfooding on the recorded hardware.
deferred_physical_dgx_gates.B16: Exact-artifact final audit on clean target systems and frozen hardware/configuration evidence.

authoritative_sources.supports: DGX Station for Windows product identity, NVIDIA Grace Arm CPU, coherent-memory and AI-performance product specifications.
Native hosted Windows Arm64 runner label used for B02 architecture-equivalent qualification.

nonclaims: The DGX Station is not qualified by this authority amendment.
Neither B02 native lane has passed.
B02 is not closed and B03 remains locked.
No GPU, model, throughput, latency, dogfood, release, or 10/10 claim is made.
